header.purpose: measure whether the M against C ordering and the shift sign survive departures from Gaussianity
header.gmm_note: 0.3 is far below the article's detection floor of 1.17, so no partition is recoverable and a rejection remains a false positive
header.covariance_matching: tau bisected once per (PR target, n) on the Gaussian; all five families in that cell share the same Sigma. Realized sphere PR is measured per cell and reported
header.seed_rule: dataset i of cell (key, family) uses seed_root + cell_offset + family_offset + 1000*i; its draws use that + 7
